profile.finding: #160 added five 36-bone crab rigs (180 bones) that three walks every frame even while the crabs are hidden down their burrows; the crab and sand-stream updates themselves cost ~0.01 and ~0.04 ms. A hidden crab now skips that walk. The 25.4 vs 22.8 of #160's CI run is inside the runner's spread (main against itself: 25.0 vs 29.6).
